title: mackintosh
summary: An everyday raincoat name with a Glasgow connection.
question: Which Charles gave the coat its name?
completion: Mackintosh is named after Charles Macintosh, a Glasgow chemist associated with waterproof fabric patented in 1823. The later architect and computer are false trails.
partner: A familiar word can carry a surprising history. Follow the evidence!
